awards.title: Tech Innovation Prize
awards.about: 36 non-stop hours at La Centrale in Vicenza to design tools against gender-based violence, organised by Movimento Donne Impresa and the Digital Innovation Hub of Confartigianato Vicenza with Cre-Ta: 71 participants in 13 teams.
awards.details: With my team we built FRIENDlyZONE, a map of perceived safety in Vicenza: a score from 0 to 100 for each of the 13,728 pedestrian streets, from twelve factors in public data and from the users' positive and negative reports, that changes with the time of day and the user's profile, with alternative routes, an SOS button and location sharing. The jury rewarded its technological integrability, algorithmic complexity and community involvement.
